stories.title: Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google face antitrust lawsuit for agreeing to slow AI development — plaintiffs say plan has been in motion for months before, calls agreement ‘self-serving’

sources.title: Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google face antitrust lawsuit for agreeing to slow AI development — plaintiffs say plan has been in motion for months before, calls agreement ‘self-serving’
sources.title_en: Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google face antitrust lawsuit for agreeing to slow AI development — plaintiffs say plan has been in motion for months before, calls agreement ‘self-serving’
sources.title_original: Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google face antitrust lawsuit for agreeing to slow AI development — plaintiffs say plan has been in motion for months before, calls agreement ‘self-serving’
sources.summary: A proposed class action lawsuit has been lodged against the four big AI tech companies after they agreed to slow AI development for safety reasons. The lead counsel on the lawsuit says that 'AI will quickly spin out of control and could kill us all if we allow AI safety and protocol ... to be controlled by private self-serving agreements between the world's most powerful 'for profit' technology companies.'
sources.summary_zh: 在四家大型人工智能科技公司同意出于安全原因放慢人工智能开发后，有人提议对它们提起集体诉讼。该诉讼的首席律师表示，“如果我们允许人工智能安全和协议……受到世界上最强大的‘营利’科技公司之间的私人自私协议的控制，人工智能将很快失控，并可能杀死我们所有人。”

primary_item.summary: An official Russian media clip shows Putin voting on a Dell PC with an unlicensed copy of Windows.
primary_item.summary_zh: 俄罗斯官方媒体剪辑显示普京在装有未经许可的 Windows 副本的戴尔 PC 上投票。

sources.title_original: Collapse of mainstream optical drive supply kills high-end CD players — PS Audio and Naim halt production as component costs double
sources.summary: PS Audio and Naim had to cease production of two Hi-Fi models as manufacturers quit making optical drives, even as CD and vinyl have hit record sales in recent months.
sources.summary_zh: 由于制造商停止生产光驱，PS Audio 和 Naim 不得不停止生产两款 Hi-Fi 型号，尽管近几个月来 CD 和黑胶唱片的销量创下了纪录。
